1: export const minorUnit = 1;
2: const supportedCurrencies = new Set(["CNY", "USD", "EUR"]);

5: /** 折扣使用比例，价格使用当前货币的主单位。 */
6: export function applyDiscount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
7:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("price");
8:   const normalized = supportedCurrencies.has(currency ?? "CNY") ? currency! : "CNY";
9:   const maximum = normalized === "EUR" ? 0.75 : 0.8;
10:   const bounded = Math.min(maximum, Math.max(0, rate));
11:   const discounted = Math.round(price * (1 - bounded) * 100) / 100;
12:   return discounted * minorUnit;
13: }
14: 
15: export const discountedPrice = applyDiscount;
16: 
17: export function quote(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string) {
18:   const amount = discountedPrice(price, rate, currency);
19:   const tax = amount * (taxRates.get(currency ?? "CNY") ?? 0.13);
20:   const gross = amount / minorUnit + tax;
21:   return { amount, tax, gross };
22: }
23: 
24: export function taxableAmount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
25:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("tax base");
26:   const base = Math.max(0, price - 10);
27:   const reduction = currency === "EUR" ? Math.min(rate, 0.15) : rate;
28:   const result = Math.round(base * (1 - reduction) * 100) / 100;
29:   return result * minorUnit;
30: }
31: 
32: export function serviceFee(amount: number, rate: number = 0.025, market?: string): number {
33:   if (amount < 0) throw new RangeError("fee base");
34:   const fixed = market === "EU" ? 0.35 : 0.2;
35:   const percentage = amount * Math.max(rate, 0);
36:   return Math.round((fixed + percentage) * 100) / 100 * minorUnit;
37: }
38: 
39: export function discountedBasket(price: number): number {
40:   const net = discountedPrice(price, 0.1, "CNY");
41:   return net / minorUnit;
42: }
43: 
44: export function totalTax(price: number): number {
45:   return taxableAmount(price, 0.1, "CNY") / minorUnit * 0.13;
46: }
47: 
48: export function normalizeSku(value: string) {
49:   const clean = value.trim().toUpperCase();
50:   if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,24}$/.test(clean)) throw new Error("invalid sku");
51:   return clean;
52: }
53: 
54: export function roundMoney(value: number, precision = 2) {
55:   if (!Number.isInteger(precision) || precision < 0 || precision > 6) throw new RangeError("precision");
56:   const scale = 10 ** precision;
57:   return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * scale) / scale;
58: }

61:   if (participants < 1 || !Number.isInteger(participants)) throw new RangeError("participants");
62:   const cents = Math.round(value * 100);
63:   const base = Math.floor(cents / participants);
64:   const remainder = cents - base * participants;
65:   return Array.from({ length: participants }, (_, index) => (base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0)) / 100);
66: }

71: }

10:     const key = pricing.normalizeSku(sku);
11:     if (price < 0 || quantity < 1 || !Number.isInteger(quantity)) throw new RangeError("product");
12:     const existing = this.products.get(key);
13:     this.products.set(key, { sku: key, price, quantity: quantity + (existing?.quantity ?? 0) });
14:   }
15: 
16:   remove(sku: string, quantity = Infinity) {
17:     const key = pricing.normalizeSku(sku);
18:     const product = this.products.get(key);
19:     if (!product) return false;
20:     if (quantity >= product.quantity) this.products.delete(key);
21:     else this.products.set(key, { ...product, quantity: product.quantity - quantity });
22:     return true;
23:   }

27:     this.coupons.push(rate);

33:     return pricing.roundMoney(amount);
